title: Asking a friend, answering for yourself

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: A yes/no question uses the same words as a statement, with your voice going up. When a friend asks you (*te*), you answer about yourself (*én*), so the ending changes: *Olvasol?* – *Igen, olvasok.* To say no, repeat *nem*: *Nem, nem olvasok.* The first *nem* is “no”; the second one negates the verb.

items.english: Do you read? – Yes, I read.
Do you cook? – No, I do not cook.
Do you walk in the afternoon? – Yes, I walk.
Does Anna read? – Yes, she reads.

sections.content: Do not answer *Főzöl?* with *Főzöl*: that says “you cook”. The answer is about you, so it is *Főzök*. When the question is about a third person, the stem stays: *Igen, olvas.*
